description: Pages similar in meaning to a given public URL, with highlights. Up to 10 results. Returns { url, results: [{ title, url, publishedDate, score, highlights }] }. Price: 8 credits (1 credit = 1 CAD cent) per successful call; input that does not match the schema is rejected before billing.

excludeSourceDomain.description: Leave out pages from the same domain as the URL (default true).

url.description: Public http(s) URL. Private, loopback, link-local and metadata addresses, internal hostnames and this service's own hosts are refused.

name: find-similar
title: Find similar pages
